title: Court of appeal: outcomes by section, 2024
bodyMd: The table reports every appeal decided in 2024 by the four sections of a regional court of appeal. Each appeal decided had exactly one of the three outcomes shown, so for each section the three outcome columns add up to the number of appeals decided.

data.caption: Appeals decided in 2024 by the Civil, Criminal, Labour and Tax sections of a regional court of appeal, split by outcome: judgment upheld, overturned in part, overturned in full.

accessibilityText: A table with five columns — section, appeals decided, judgment upheld, overturned in part, overturned in full — and four rows. The Civil section decided 600 appeals: 360 upheld, 150 overturned in part, 90 overturned in full. The Criminal section decided 400 appeals: 200 upheld, 120 overturned in part, 80 overturned in full. The Labour section decided 300 appeals: 210 upheld, 60 overturned in part, 30 overturned in full. The Tax section decided 200 appeals: 80 upheld, 70 overturned in part, 50 overturned in full. In every row the three outcome figures add up to the appeals-decided figure.

provenance.notes: Invented data for a fictional court. The section names and counts are not those of any real court; the figures were chosen so that every share is a round percentage computable without a calculator.
